0.en: The alarm on Jack's wrist went at a quarter past four, and he was awake before the second buzz.
0.id: Alarm di pergelangan Jack berbunyi pukul empat lewat seperempat, dan ia sudah terjaga sebelum getaran kedua.

1.en: The other side of the bed was empty.

2.en: He found Sarah on the couch in the dark, wrapped in the blue blanket, with the tablet glowing on her knees. Four camera feeds filled the screen. Three were black. The fourth showed the greenhouse door, lit by a single work lamp, and the round white face of the old thermometer screwed to the frame.
2.id: Ia menemukan Sarah di sofa dalam gelap, terbungkus selimut biru, dengan tablet menyala di lututnya. Empat tayangan kamera memenuhi layar. Tiga hitam. Yang keempat menampilkan pintu rumah kaca, diterangi satu lampu kerja, dan muka bundar putih termometer tua yang disekrup ke kusennya.

5.en: So is he. He's been kicking since three. I think he knows.
5.id: Dia juga. Dia sudah menendang-nendang sejak jam tiga. Kurasa dia tahu.

6.en: He doesn't know anything. He's the size of a melon.
6.id: Dia tidak tahu apa-apa. Besarnya cuma seukuran melon.

7.en: A melon that kicks. Sit down. Give me your hand.
7.id: Melon yang bisa menendang. Duduk. Sini tanganmu.

8.en: She had the surgical glove and the clear plastic bag ready on the arm of the couch, and a roll of tape. She worked the glove over his left hand, slowly, so it wouldn't pull at the stitches, then the bag over that, and taped it twice around his wrist. Then she pressed the tape down all the way around with her thumb, the way Doctor Mercer did.
8.id: Ia sudah menyiapkan sarung tangan bedah dan kantong plastik bening di lengan sofa, juga segulung plester. Ia memasangkan sarung tangan itu ke tangan kiri Jack, pelan-pelan, supaya tidak menarik jahitannya, lalu kantong di atasnya, dan melilitkan plester dua kali di pergelangannya. Lalu ia menekan plester itu dengan ibu jarinya di sepanjang lilitan, seperti yang dilakukan Dokter Mercer.

9.en: Doctor Mercer said take it off the second you're back in the truck.
9.id: Kata Dokter Mercer, lepaskan begitu kamu kembali di truk.

11.en: I'm telling you anyway. You're going to be cold, and wet, and pleased with yourself, and you'll forget.
11.id: Aku tetap bilang. Kamu bakal kedinginan, dan basah, dan puas dengan dirimu sendiri, dan kamu bakal lupa.

12.en: He kissed the top of her head.

15.en: Mark was outside at twenty to five, with the motor running and the headlights off. Behind him, so close that its bumper nearly touched, sat Paul's flatbed. The trough was lashed down on the back of it under a gray tarp, with the long pole strapped along its side.
15.id: Mark sudah di luar pukul lima kurang dua puluh, dengan mesin menyala dan lampu depan mati. Di belakangnya, begitu dekat sampai bempernya nyaris bersentuhan, ada truk pengangkut Paul. Talang itu diikat di bak belakangnya di bawah terpal kelabu, dengan tiang panjang diikat di sepanjang sisinya.

16.en: Paul was in the driver's seat.

17.en: Jack leaned in at Mark's window.
17.id: Jack mencondongkan badan ke jendela Mark.

18.en: I thought his crew was bringing it.

19.en: Mark kept his eyes on the road.
19.id: Mata Mark tetap tertuju ke jalan.

21.en: Paul's voice came from the flatbed's open window, low and gravelly.
21.id: Suara Paul terdengar dari jendela truk yang terbuka, rendah dan serak.

22.en: I built it. I'm not watching it go off the back of a truck on a camera. I'll stop at the cart. I know the rule.
22.id: Saya yang membuatnya. Saya tidak mau menontonnya diturunkan dari bak truk lewat kamera. Saya berhenti di kereta. Saya tahu aturannya.

23.en: Mark looked at him in the mirror for a long moment.
23.id: Mark memandangnya lewat kaca spion cukup lama.

24.en: The cart. Not one step past it.
24.id: Kereta. Tidak selangkah pun lewat dari situ.

26.en: They drove by the streetlights as far as they went, the flatbed following without lights, a dark shape in the mirror. At the last streetlight, Mark stopped long enough for Aiden to get out with his flashlight and his notebook. He walked off toward the long, dark roof of the greenhouse without looking back.
26.id: Mereka menyetir mengikuti lampu jalan sejauh lampu itu ada, truk pengangkut menyusul tanpa lampu, sosok gelap di kaca spion. Di lampu jalan terakhir, Mark berhenti cukup lama supaya Aiden bisa turun membawa senter dan buku catatannya. Aiden berjalan pergi ke arah atap panjang rumah kaca yang gelap tanpa menoleh.

27.en: A minute later, his voice came over the channel, very quiet.
27.id: Semenit kemudian, suaranya terdengar di kanal, sangat pelan.

28.en: I'm at the door. Five degrees. And every star I've ever seen.
28.id: Aku di pintu. Lima derajat. Dan semua bintang yang pernah kulihat.

30.en: Station hears you. Five, and clear.

31.en: Sarah's voice came on after it, softer.

32.en: I'm on the couch. I have the feeds. Nobody needs to worry about me.
32.id: Aku di sofa. Tayangannya ada di depanku. Tidak ada yang perlu mengkhawatirkanku.

33.en: Mark didn't answer that. He switched off the dashboard lights, picked up the small red lamp, and drove the last stretch slowly, by memory, with the lamp cupped in his hand and pointed straight down.
33.id: Mark tidak menanggapinya. Ia mematikan lampu dasbor, mengambil lampu merah kecil, dan menempuh ruas terakhir pelan-pelan, mengandalkan ingatan, dengan lampu itu ditangkupkan di tangannya dan diarahkan lurus ke bawah.

34.en: The white cart came out of the dark, pale and square. Mark stopped twenty meters back and cut the motor. Behind them, the flatbed rolled to a stop and went quiet.
34.id: Kereta putih itu muncul dari kegelapan, pucat dan persegi. Mark berhenti dua puluh meter di belakangnya dan mematikan mesin. Di belakang mereka, truk pengangkut menggelinding berhenti dan menjadi senyap.

35.en: The sounds came back the way they had two mornings before. The slow dry clicking in the stems. The hum that came and went. Somewhere far out on the island, a long creak, like a door that nobody would ever close.
35.id: Bunyi-bunyi itu kembali seperti dua pagi sebelumnya. Bunyi klik yang kering dan lambat di antara batang rumput. Dengung yang datang dan pergi. Di suatu tempat jauh di pulau, derit panjang, seperti pintu yang tak akan pernah ditutup siapa pun.

36.en: Unit Four got out first and went straight to the cart, with the rope over his shoulder. He tied it off at the tow hitch, leaned his whole weight into it, and then did it again. Nobody had told him to do it twice.
36.id: Unit Empat turun lebih dulu dan langsung menuju kereta, dengan tali tersampir di bahunya. Ia mengikatkan tali itu ke kait derek, menumpukan seluruh bobot tubuhnya ke tali, lalu melakukannya lagi. Tak ada yang menyuruhnya melakukannya dua kali.

37.en: Paul and his two men slid a pair of planks off the back of the flatbed and set them against the bed. The trough came down them on its short steel feet, slowly, with Paul at the bottom calling every inch in a whisper.
37.id: Paul dan dua anak buahnya menurunkan sepasang papan dari belakang truk dan menyandarkannya ke bak. Talang itu meluncur turun di atasnya dengan kaki-kaki baja pendeknya, pelan-pelan, dengan Paul di bawah membisikkan aba-aba untuk setiap senti.

38.en: Easy. Easy. Your end's high. Easy.

39.en: It touched the asphalt with a soft metal scrape that sounded, in that silence, like a car crash.
39.id: Talang itu menyentuh aspal dengan gesekan logam yang pelan, yang dalam keheningan itu terdengar seperti tabrakan mobil.

40.id: Semua orang berhenti. Tak ada yang bernapas.

41.en: The clicking in the stems went on, slow and dry, exactly as before.
41.id: Bunyi klik di antara batang rumput terus berlanjut, lambat dan kering, persis seperti sebelumnya.

42.en: Mark let out his breath through his nose.

43.en: Lift it. Don't drag it. Nothing gets dragged.
43.id: Angkat. Jangan diseret. Tidak ada yang diseret.

44.en: Jack, Mark and Paul's two men took a corner each. Paul stayed at the cart beside Unit Four, his hands pushed deep in his pockets as though he had to keep them there by force. They carried the trough forward in the red glow, one short step at a time, toward the place where the asphalt ended.
44.id: Jack, Mark, dan dua anak buah Paul masing-masing memegang satu sudut. Paul tetap di kereta di samping Unit Empat, kedua tangannya terbenam dalam-dalam di saku seolah ia harus menahannya di sana dengan paksa. Mereka membawa talang itu maju dalam cahaya merah, satu langkah pendek demi satu langkah pendek, menuju tempat aspal berakhir.

45.en: The channel gave a tiny click. Sarah's voice came through, barely above a breath.
45.id: Kanal berbunyi klik kecil. Suara Sarah terdengar, nyaris hanya embusan napas.

46.en: There's a crack across the road. On yesterday's footage, the big drop hung right over it. A meter past the cart's line, and a little to the right. Look for the crack.
46.id: Ada retakan melintang di jalan. Di rekaman kemarin, tetesan besar itu menggantung tepat di atasnya. Semeter lewat dari garis kereta, dan sedikit ke kanan. Cari retakannya.

47.en: Mark swung the red lamp down, slowly, across the asphalt. A dark seam ran across the road in front of their boots, wide enough to catch a heel.
47.id: Mark mengayunkan lampu merah itu ke bawah, pelan-pelan, menyapu aspal. Sebuah celah gelap melintang di jalan di depan sepatu bot mereka, cukup lebar untuk menjebak tumit.

49.en: They set the trough down on the far side of the crack, with the end of the road right in front of it and the tall splash board on their own side. It stood there like a wall between them and the grass.
49.id: Mereka menaruh talang itu di sisi seberang retakan, dengan ujung jalan tepat di depannya dan papan penahan cipratan yang tinggi di sisi mereka sendiri. Papan itu berdiri di sana seperti dinding antara mereka dan rumput.

51.en: Number three on my list. The biggest drops are under its front door. If that one is, when the light comes, we move. Two meters, either way.
51.id: Nomor tiga di daftarku. Tetesan paling besar ada di bawah pintu depannya. Kalau yang itu juga begitu, begitu terang datang, kita pindah. Dua meter, ke arah mana pun.

52.en: Jack nodded in the dark. They had argued it at the station the night before. You couldn't point a light up into the stems to check. You could only wait for the gray, and look.
52.id: Jack mengangguk dalam gelap. Mereka sudah memperdebatkannya di stasiun malam sebelumnya. Tidak mungkin menyorotkan lampu ke atas, ke antara batang rumput, untuk memeriksa. Yang bisa dilakukan hanya menunggu kelabu, lalu melihat.

53.en: Jack clipped onto the rope at the front, behind the board, with Mark behind him. Paul's men walked back to the cart without a word. Then there was nothing to do but stand there with the cold coming up through his boots and wait.
53.id: Jack mengaitkan diri ke tali di depan, di balik papan, dengan Mark di belakangnya. Anak buah Paul berjalan kembali ke kereta tanpa sepatah kata. Lalu tak ada lagi yang bisa dilakukan selain berdiri di sana, dengan dingin merambat naik lewat sepatu botnya, dan menunggu.

54.en: The sky went from black to charcoal.
54.id: Langit berubah dari hitam menjadi kelabu arang.

55.en: Lena's voice came in, right on time.

56.id: Dua menit. Semua masih di sana?

57.en: Jack kept his voice to a whisper.

60.en: The wall of grass took shape in front of them, stem by stem. The blades came out of the dark, pale and bending. And along them, one after another, the drops came out too, small ones along every edge like strings of glass, bigger ones higher up.
60.id: Dinding rumput mulai berbentuk di depan mereka, batang demi batang. Bilah-bilahnya muncul dari kegelapan, pucat dan melengkung. Dan di sepanjang bilah itu, satu demi satu, tetesan-tetesan juga muncul, yang kecil di sepanjang setiap tepi seperti untaian kaca, yang lebih besar lebih tinggi di atas.

61.en: Then Jack saw the big one. It hung at the tip of a long blade, three meters up, heavy and round and perfectly still, right above the trough. Paul had built the trough for exactly that drop.
61.id: Lalu Jack melihat yang besar. Tetesan itu menggantung di ujung sebilah daun panjang, tiga meter di atas, berat dan bulat dan diam sempurna, tepat di atas talang. Paul membuat talang itu persis untuk tetesan seperti itu.

62.en: He let his eyes follow the blade back, up and into the stems.
62.id: Ia membiarkan matanya mengikuti bilah itu ke pangkalnya, naik dan masuk ke antara batang-batang rumput.

63.en: The silk retreat hung there. It hung from the same stem as Jack's blade, not a meter above it, pale and quiet.
63.id: Tempat persembunyian dari sutra itu menggantung di sana. Ia menggantung di batang yang sama dengan bilah daun Jack, tak sampai semeter di atasnya, pucat dan diam.

64.en: Behind him, Mark had seen it too.
64.id: Di belakangnya, Mark juga sudah melihatnya.

65.en: On the channel, Sarah's voice was so quiet it was hardly a voice at all.
65.id: Di kanal, suara Sarah begitu pelan sampai nyaris tidak terdengar seperti suara.

66.en: It's under the front door. Mark, I see it on the feed. There's another one, two meters left. Smaller. Nothing above it.
66.id: Itu di bawah pintu depan. Mark, kelihatan di tayangan. Ada satu lagi, dua meter ke kiri. Lebih kecil. Tidak ada apa-apa di atasnya.

67.en: Jack found it. A shorter blade, bending lower over the road, with a drop at its tip that held maybe half the water of the first. Above it there was nothing but stems and gray. No silk.
67.id: Jack menemukannya. Bilah yang lebih pendek, melengkung lebih rendah di atas jalan, dengan tetesan di ujungnya yang mungkin berisi separuh air yang pertama. Di atasnya tak ada apa-apa selain batang rumput dan kelabu. Tidak ada sutra.

68.en: Mark's voice was barely a breath.
68.id: Suara Mark nyaris hanya embusan napas.

70.en: Jack kept his eyes on the smaller drop.
70.id: Mata Jack tetap tertuju pada tetesan yang lebih kecil.

71.en: Half the water. Nowhere near its front door.
71.id: Separuh airnya. Jauh dari pintu depannya.

72.en: Mark was quiet for one second. Two.
72.id: Mark diam selama satu detik. Dua.

73.en: We move it. Two meters left. Lift it. Don't drag it.
73.id: Kita pindahkan. Dua meter ke kiri. Angkat. Jangan diseret.

74.en: They called the two men back from the cart by hand signal, and the four of them took the trough by its corners and lifted. It was heavier than it had been in the dark. Jack's bagged hand slid on the cold metal, and he changed his grip. They carried it left, one short step, then another, with the board between them and the grass and the gray growing all the time. Jack counted every step in his head. He couldn't have said afterward how many there were.
74.id: Mereka memanggil dua orang itu kembali dari kereta dengan isyarat tangan, dan mereka berempat memegang talang itu di sudut-sudutnya lalu mengangkatnya. Talang itu lebih berat daripada waktu di dalam gelap. Tangan Jack yang terbungkus kantong tergelincir di logam yang dingin, dan ia mengubah pegangannya. Mereka membawanya ke kiri, satu langkah pendek, lalu satu lagi, dengan papan di antara mereka dan rumput, dan kelabu terus bertambah terang. Jack menghitung setiap langkah dalam kepalanya. Sesudahnya ia tak bisa mengatakan berapa jumlahnya.

75.en: They set it down under the smaller drop. The two men walked back to the cart. Paul hadn't moved from the cart, and he didn't now.
75.id: Mereka menaruhnya di bawah tetesan yang lebih kecil. Kedua orang itu berjalan kembali ke kereta. Paul tidak beranjak dari kereta, dan sekarang pun tidak.

76.en: Aiden's voice came over the channel.

77.id: Empat derajat. Tidak ada awan sama sekali.

80.en: Somewhere out on the island, the robin started again, bright and sweet and ordinary.
80.id: Di suatu tempat di pulau, burung robin itu mulai berkicau lagi, nyaring dan merdu dan biasa saja.

81.en: Mark leaned close behind Jack, so close that Jack could feel the words on the back of his neck.
81.id: Mark mencondongkan badan dekat di belakang Jack, begitu dekat sampai Jack bisa merasakan kata-katanya di tengkuknya.

82.en: One leaf. One lift. One drop. Then the lid, slow. Then we're gone.
82.id: Satu daun. Satu kali angkat. Satu tetesan. Lalu tutupnya, pelan. Lalu kita pergi.

85.en: Jack raised the pole over the top of the splash board. The padded fork rose into the gray, past the edge of the board, past the strings of glass along the blade, until it was under the leaf, a hand's width from the place where the tip began to bend.
85.id: Jack mengangkat tiang itu melewati puncak papan penahan cipratan. Garpu berbantalan itu naik ke dalam kelabu, melewati tepi papan, melewati untaian kaca di sepanjang bilah, sampai berada di bawah daun, selebar telapak tangan dari tempat ujungnya mulai melengkung.
